title: System Architecture
content: Apply system architecture aesthetic with technical design documentation feel. Component boxes with icons and labels. Layer diagrams (presentation, business, data). Arrows showing data/control flow. Service boundaries. Interface definitions. Dependency arrows. Module groupings. API gateway representations. System design documentation atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create software architecture aesthetic with component diagrams, layer visualization, and technical documentation styling.
variants.detailed: Apply system architecture aesthetic with technical design documentation feel. Component boxes with icons and labels. Layer diagrams (presentation, business, data). Arrows showing data/control flow. Service boundaries. Interface definitions. Dependency arrows. Module groupings. API gateway representations. System design documentation atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply system architecture aesthetic with enterprise architecture documentation feel. Component styling: rounded rectangles with icon + label, consistent sizing, color-coded by type (UI blue, service green, database purple, external gray). Layer diagrams: horizontal bands representing architectural layers - presentation (top), application/business logic, domain, infrastructure, data (bottom). Flow arrows: solid for synchronous calls, dashed for async/events, labeled with protocols (HTTP, gRPC, AMQP). Arrow heads: direction indicators, optional cardinality. Service boundaries: bounded context boxes with service mesh representation. Microservices: each service as box, internal components shown on drill-down. APIs: interface boxes on service edges, REST/GraphQL badges. Message queues: queue icon between services, topic/queue labels. Databases: cylinder shapes, replication indicators, read/write separation. Caching: lightning bolt cache layer, Redis/Memcached icons. Load balancers: balance scale icon, distribution arrows. CDN: edge location indicators, content distribution. External services: cloud shape or different border style, third-party badges. Containers: docker-style boxed deployments, Kubernetes pod groupings. Infrastructure as Code: Terraform-style resource blocks. Sequence diagrams: timeline-style interaction flows. C4 model: Context, Container, Component, Code zoom levels. Decision records: ADR-style documentation blocks. Non-functional: performance annotations, security zones, compliance boundaries. Version: diagram version, last updated date. Implementation: SVG or diagramming library output styling. Accessibility: architecture diagrams need comprehensive text descriptions.
